luit.openTerminal.title: Open Terminal...
luit.refreshEncodings.title: Refresh Encoding List
luit.luitPath.markdownDescription: Path to the `luit` executable. Leave empty to search `PATH` automatically.
luit.defaultEncoding.markdownDescription:
Encoding to use without prompting (for example `eucJP`). Leave empty to choose an encoding every time from `luit -list`.

Set this when you point `#terminal.integrated.defaultProfile.linux#` at the luit profile, otherwise every terminal you open shows the encoding picker.
luit.shellPath.markdownDescription: Shell to run inside `luit`. Leave empty to use `$SHELL`, falling back to `bash`.
luit.shellArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments passed to the shell specified by `#luit.shellPath#`.
luit.rememberLastEncoding.description: Show the last used encoding at the top of the encoding picker.
luit.env.markdownDescription: Environment variables for the terminal. `luit` does not change the shell's locale, so the shell must already emit the encoding you selected. If it does not, set `LANG` here, for example `{"LANG": "ja_JP.eucJP"}`. Set a value to `null` to remove that variable.
